newsitem.title: FRANCE: French ruling coalition holds election lead-poll.
newsitem.headline: French ruling coalition holds election lead-poll.

text.p: Following are the results of an opinion poll of voters' intentions ahead of the May 25/June 1 parlimentary election.

The telephone poll of 1,023 adults aged 18 and over was conducted by CSA on May 12 and 13 for France 3 television, France Inter and France Info radio stations and Le Parisien newspaper and made public on May 13:

NOTE: CSA said 81 percent of those polled said they were very sure they would vote as projected and 19 percent gave no opinion or could still change their minds. CSA did not say how many seats ecologist candidates would win. It included the ecologists' seats within the 237 seats projected for the left. The extreme left is not expected to win any seats in the assembly. The poll covered the 555 seats in mainland France and not the 22 seats in overseas territories, most of which typically go to centre-right candidates.
